items.title: The Hornets say Kon Knueppel suffered a left hamstring injury and Grant Williams suffered a right hamstring injury during offseason on-court activity.
items.author: J.E. Skeets
items.body_excerpt:
The Hornets say Kon Knueppel suffered a left hamstring injury and Grant Williams suffered a right hamstring injury during offseason on-court activity. 

Wild timing. 

I talked to Grant earlier this week — the podcast drops tomorrow — and he was excited to enter this season healthy. 😔

items.title: Just In: Kon Knueppel suffered a left hamstring injury and Grant Williams suffered a right hamstring injury during offseason on-court activity. The Charlotte Hornets say both players will miss their preseason games and be re-evaluated during the first week of the regular season.

items.title: From Derrick White to Grant Williams, Jordan Walsh, and Ron Harper Jr., the Celtics have a proven track record of helping shooters improve.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
From Derrick White to Grant Williams, Jordan Walsh, and Ron Harper Jr., the Celtics have a proven track record of helping shooters improve.

Now, they have a chance to help Devin Carter elevate his career trajectory.
